title: Build a workout app for Apple Watch

SummaryView - SummaryMetricViews using HKWorkout values
codeSnippets.code:
SummaryMetricView(
    title: "Total Time",
    value: durationFormatter
        .string(from: workoutManager.workout?.duration ?? 0.0) ?? ""
).accentColor(Color.yellow)
SummaryMetricView(
    title: "Total Distance",
    value: Measurement(
        value: workoutManager.workout?.totalDistance?
            .doubleValue(for: .meter()) ?? 0,
        unit: UnitLength.meters
    ).formatted(
        .measurement(
            width: .abbreviated,
            usage: .road
        )
    )
).accentColor(Color.green)
SummaryMetricView(
    title: "Total Energy",
    value: Measurement(
        value: workoutManager.workout?.totalEnergyBurned?
                        .doubleValue(for: .kilocalorie()) ?? 0,
        unit: UnitEnergy.kilocalories
    ).formatted(
        .measurement(
            width: .abbreviated,
            usage: .workout,
            numberFormat: .numeric(precision: .fractionLength(0))
        )
    )
).accentColor(Color.pink)
SummaryMetricView(
    title: "Avg. Heart Rate",
    value: workoutManager.averageHeartRate
        .formatted(
            .number.precision(.fractionLength(0))
        )
    + " bpm"
).accentColor(Color.red)
